Population increased in North West Leicestershire

The estimated population of North West Leicestershire in 2024 was 111,881 usual residents, a rise of 1.5% since 2023.

This meant that North West Leicestershire's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of North West Leicestershire increased by 6.5%.

Over this slightly longer period, North West Leicestershire was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of North West Leicestershire

The average (median) age stayed at 42.7 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of North West Leicestershire has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
North West Leicestershire is an area that is classed as intermediate rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, North West Leicestershire's population of 111,881 usual residents was made up of:

  • 19,677 people aged 0 to 15 years, (17.6%)
  • 69,701 people aged 16 to 64 years, (62.3%)
  • 22,503 people aged 65 years and over, (20.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, North West Leicestershire has a slightly higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (20.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In North West Leicestershire, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in North West Leicestershire
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for North West Leicestershire, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More births than deaths increased the population of 28 people (0%). In total, there were 1,018 births and 990 deaths in North West Leicestershire.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,434 (1.3%). There were 6,934 people entering the area and 5,500 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in North West Leicestershire's population of 211 (0.2%) as a result of 432 people entering the area and 221 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for North West Leicestershire was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of North West Leicestershire in mid-2023 is 110,203.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 235 people and internal migration estimates were revised downwards by 348 people.

Overall, there was an revision downwards of 113 people.
